- **Orbital period:** 4.05 days (“pl_orbper = 4.05”, i.e., > 1 day).

These are the only terrestrial exoplanets that satisfy all four criteria (smaller‑than‑Earth radius, transit discovery, period > 1 day, orbiting an M‑type star) among the planets first announced in 2017 on the NASA Exoplanet Archive.
